chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad [from a man] from Abu al-Maghra' from al-Halbi who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who hired an animal to a known place, so the animal died. He (peace be upon him) said: If he exceeded the condition, he is liable; and if he entered a valley without securing it (for safety), he is liable; and if it fell into a well, he is liable, because he did not secure it from it.
ai.seo_question: What is the liability of a hirer if the hired animal dies during the journey?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of *dhaman* (liability) in hire contracts, emphasizing that negligence in securing the animal or deviating from the agreed path voids the hirer's protection. It serves as a foundational juristic text for understanding risk allocation in *ijarah* (leasing) within Shia fiqh, linking physical safety measures to legal responsibility. The ruling underscores the importance of fulfilling contractual conditions (*shart*) and exercising due diligence (*istiwath*) during the hired period.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from a man, from Abu Al Magra, from Al Halby who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who hired an animal up to a known place. So the animal died’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he had exceeded the stipulation, so he is responsible, and if he entered a valley not trusting it (for safety), so he is responsible, and if it falls into a well, so he is responsible, because he was not ensured from it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from a man from abu al-Mighra’ from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “

This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who rents a stumper to a certain place but it dies. He (the Imam) said, ‘If he has violated the stipulation he is responsible, if he enters a valley where he is not confident for its safety, he then is responsible, if it falls in a well where for its safety he is not confident, he is responsible.’”
